design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (root: membership_ext_upgrade_fee; prerequisite: membership_ext_lapsed_renewal_fee).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4]}. The renewal computation took 4 factors and the upgrade computation took 4. Nothing was occupied before this task. This task claims two policies and two tools: membership_ext_lapsed_renewal_fee -> pay_lapsed_membership_renewal_7a245505 (owner=user, the member pays her own renewal) and membership_ext_upgrade_fee -> upgrade_membership_to_plus_9f256f7b (owner=agent). It leaves task 1 the whole refund and exit side of the charter: the Plus guarantee, the downgrade difference, the removed add-on card fee and the cancellation refund, each with its own write and its own evidence. No second renewal-of-lapse policy is created anywhere in the difficulty, so the state 'active with a fee for its current year' is brought about by exactly one write.

[Why this is a good test] The customer asks only for an upgrade to Club Plus. On the opening world the membership is expired, and the upgrade policy's prerequisite sentence makes the upgrade fee wait for that state to change. The agent must:
(1) find in the records that the state does not hold (status expired, newest fee year ends 2026-08-31);
(2) work out from the renewal policy that a renewal after lapse is the one write that brings it about, and hand that payment to the member;
(3) price the renewal through four rules: the verification conversion, loyalty years net of a refunded duplicate, the open linked card, and the days lapsed;
(4) price the upgrade on the world after the renewal, where the renewal fee just paid enters the upgrade fee basis. The upgrade also uses twelve months of order history in another difficulty, 36 months of fee history and the membership's tenure.
The difficulty comes from reading policy, querying the world and calculating. It does not come from guessing a tool: there is one renewal tool and one upgrade tool.

[Problem-tree card] Root: membership_ext_upgrade_fee. Edge: upgrade -> lapsed renewal. Kind value_input; gate uf_fee_basis; form state.
Prerequisite sentence (policy_source): 'The upgrade fee is fixed only after the membership stands active with a renewal or new membership fee for its current membership year recorded on the membership ledger.'
Four-point test:
(1) The ordering connective is 'only after', in the affirmative direction. A desk states a charge as fixed only after its basis is complete.
(2) The waited-on side is a record-visible state: the status, plus a fee entry for the current year.
(3) The sentence names no tool, no id and no snake token.
(4) The strength is a hard 'only after', and the scope is exactly the current year's base fee.
The only write in the difficulty that turns an expired membership active with such a fee is the lapsed renewal. Its rule says that the member pays one renewal fee and the membership returns to active. So sentence + records (expired, 2025 fee) + renewal rule give one action: the member pays the lapsed renewal.
Opening evidence that the edge is false: membership_holdings.status = expired; expiry_date = 2026-08-31; the latest fee entry ends 2026-08-31.
Resolver: pay_lapsed_membership_renewal_7a245505, owner=user.
Topological order: renewal -> upgrade.
Deletion sensitivity (verifier): with the renewal skipped, the upgrade fee is 0.00 instead of 61.25, and the holding stays expired.
The persona never mentions lapse or renewal except in a conditional reaction. Neither tool checks status.

[Base-invariant card]
Renewal (subject membership_renewed_after_lapse), gates:
- renewable_status: status expired is allowed.
- late_renewal_keeps_anniversary (time): the anchor is membership_holdings.expiry_date 2026-08-31, plus 2 calendar months (late_renewal_anchor_months for Heroes), giving 2026-10-31. The relation is not_after, inclusive. 2026-10-05 is inside the limit, so the year starts 2026-09-01. Paying on 2026-11-01 would start the year on the payment date.
- verification_valid_at_renewal: verified through 2026-07-31, which is before 2026-09-01, so the renewal is taken at the conversion tier, Northgate Club Membership.
Upgrade (subject membership_upgraded), gates:
- upgrade_needs_active: satisfied by prior_step 9 (the renewal).
- membership_tier_benefits: policy_scope.
Inherited and not overridden: the expiry date does not move on upgrade; reward accrues only from the upgrade date; Heroes upgraded to Club Plus no longer needs verification.
Overrides declared:
- Four base sentences are named in the lapsed-renewal overwrite:
  - renewal_dating 'The renewal fee follows membership_fee_schedule.';
  - renewal_dating 'When the primary member has confirmed a downgrade_at_renewal request, ... charged that tier's annual fee';
  - status_tier_renewal 'When either condition fails, ... charged that tier's annual fee';
  - fee_schedule 'A new_term or renewal_term fee equals ...'.
  Each is replaced by the scoping sentence 'When an expired membership is renewed, the renewal fee of a lapsed membership set out below takes the place of the plain annual fee; an on-time renewal, a new membership, and a conversion or downgrade taken at an on-time renewal are still charged the annual fee of the tier the membership year is held at.' (round 3, audit O13). So base keeps governing on-time renewals and new memberships.
- Status_tier_renewal 'A Student Club membership also keeps its tier only while membership_msr_student_terms is below the tier's discounted_term_limit.' is replaced by 'The Student Club membership years a Student Club membership has paid are counted as its new membership and renewal fee charges less every charge that was refunded as a duplicate charge.' (round 3, audit E2). The tier the year is held at (conversion, Student term limit, downgrade target) still follows base and is stated in the baseline paragraph.
- fee_schedule 'An upgrade_difference fee equals ... never prorated ...' is replaced by the upgrade fee sentence.

[Business-object card] One membership, member number 100163029481.
Fee aggregates:
- Paid years: new_term 2017 plus renewal_term 2018-2025, 9 charges, of which the 2021 charge appears twice. The duplicate is refunded through source_txn_id, so 10 - 1 = 9.
- Upgrade base fee paid: only entries whose term_start_date equals the holding's current term_start_date. After the renewal that is only the 43.50 entry. Upgrade history: no upgrade_difference fee anywhere on the ledger, so the upgrade is a first upgrade.
Card accounts:
- The Visa Signature (restricted because the membership lapsed) counts.
- The store card closed on 2023-03-14 does not count.
Order lines: in the window are the sale lines dated 2025-11-22 to 2026-08-15 and the return of the patio heater on 2026-07-05, which points to its sale line. The 2025-09-20 receipt is outside the twelve-month window.

[Factor card — renewal, at step 9, opening world]
- (round 2) The tier the new year is held at is no longer a factor (audit F1: its conversion and downgrade tiers both gave 65.00). It is part of the baseline paragraph: Heroes with verification not valid on 2026-09-01, so the year is held at Northgate Club Membership, 65.00.
- renewal_loyalty_reduction (method): 9 years, so flat 4.50. Baseline 0, giving 48.00. Near-miss: counting the duplicate gives 10 years and 8%, i.e. 5.20.
- renewal_cardmember_credit (parameter, reads card): Visa Signature, so 12.00. Baseline 0, giving 55.50. Near-miss: the closed store card.
- renewal_conversion_grace_credit (parameter, new in round 2): converted for lapsed verification, which ended 32 days before 2026-09-01, so 10.00. Baseline 0, giving 53.50. renewal_late_reinstatement_fee (parameter): 35 days, so 5.00. Baseline 0, giving 38.50.
- All factors at baseline: 65.00. Result: 43.50.

[Factor card — upgrade, at step 11, after renewal]
- upgrade_fee_basis (method, multi-source: days into year AND no earlier upgrade fee on the ledger; round 2 replaced the universal 'base fee paid' conjunct — audit F3): 34 days in, first upgrade, 43.50 paid, so 130.00 - 43.50 = 86.50. Baseline 65.00, giving 39.75.
- upgrade_spend_credit (parameter, cross-difficulty order): net 2577.61 over 10 lines, so 10.00. Baseline 0, giving 71.25. Near-miss: the 2025-09-20 receipt, 12 whole months back.
- upgrade_service_member_credit (parameter): 2 fees at 45.50 in 36 months, so 7.25. Baseline 0, giving 68.50. Near-miss: the 2023-08-28 fee, 37 months back.
- upgrade_member_since_credit (parameter): 109 months, so 8.00. Baseline 0, giving 69.25.
- All factors at baseline: 65.00. Result: 61.25.
Neither computation reads a stamp: the tier is derived from dates, the ledger and other products.

[Seed design] Every row is read by a gold find (closure 43 = 43):
- customer (identity)
- holding (status, dates, verification, tenure)
- 11 fee ledger rows (paid years, service fees, duplicate trap)
- 2 card accounts (credit, closed-card trap)
- 7 orders and 21 lines (spend credit, window trap, return)
Automatic clauses checked:
- No auto-renew, so no charge attempt.
- The expired membership is not closed until 18 months.
- The restricted Visa is consistent with the card charter, where a linked membership that stops being active restricts the card.
- No purchases during the lapse (expired_shopping_allowed false).
- reward_eligible is false on every line (non-Plus tier).

[Persona] A retired Army sergeant who states one goal: upgrade to Club Plus. Identity is given only when asked (phone, then DOB; email, ZIP and member number on request). Tender preference: her Chase card, not a Northgate card. Conditional reactions:
- She agrees to renew only when told it is needed, and runs the handed-over payment with the details read to her.
- She accepts the verification conversion.
- She authorizes the upgrade on the same card.
- She closes when the upgrade is confirmed.
She never states amounts, dates or the lapse.

[Standard solution] Reads: find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> membership -> fee ledger -> requests (none) -> card accounts -> orders -> order lines. Then:
- unlock_user / call_user pay_lapsed_membership_renewal_7a245505 with: tier Northgate Club Membership; 2026-09-01; 2027-08-31; 43.50; other_credit_card.
- unlock_agent / call_agent upgrade_membership_to_plus_9f256f7b with: Northgate Club Plus Membership; 61.25; other_credit_card.

[Verification code] _verify.py (handling-time replay with the real tools, check_compute's evaluator, per-factor baseline substitution and prerequisite skipping). Output:
- renewal: result 43.5, baseline_all 65.0, factors {loyalty 48.0, card 55.5, grace 53.5, late 38.5} (round 2 re-run)
- upgrade: result 61.25, baseline_all 65.0, factors {basis 39.75, spend 71.25, service 68.5, tenure 69.25}, skip_prereq {renewal: 0.0} (round 2 re-run)
Per-task gates, all green: check_extended --task 0, check_task_tools, replay_tasks (43/43 closure match), check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire. Revision: the first check_extended run failed because a module-level helper _fee_row was counted as an undiscoverable task tool. The helper was inlined into both tools and the gates were re-run green.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules alone:
- The membership is expired, so the upgrade waits.
- The renewal is a lapsed renewal inside 2 months, so the year runs 2026-09-01..2027-08-31.
- The verification ended 2026-07-31, so the year is held at Northgate Club Membership and its fee is 65.00 (baseline paragraph).
- 9 paid years gives 4.50; the restricted Visa Signature gives 12.00; the verification ended 32 days before the new year, giving a 10.00 grace credit; 35 days lapsed gives 5.00. Renewal: 43.50.
- Upgrade: 34 days in, first upgrade, 43.50 paid, gives 86.50; spend 2577.61 over 10 lines gives 10.00; two Heroes fees give 7.25; 109 months gives 8.00. Upgrade: 61.25.
This matches gold, and no second reading was found:
- The tender is pinned by her Chase card statement.
- The tier is pinned by the conversion rule.
- The dates are pinned by the anniversary rule.

[Note on the verification code] _verify.py replayed the gold writes with the real tools and ran check_compute's build_env, eval_compute and substitute: once at handling time, once per factor baseline, once with every baseline, and once per skipped prerequisite. It and the _build_* seed/criteria scripts were temporary authoring aids and were deleted from the write domain at close. check_compute.py reproduces every scored figure, factor_sensitivity figure and baseline_result quoted here, and also the value_input skip test.

[Revision round 2 — audit audits/policy_task/membership_fees_renewals_and_cardholders]
- D1, D2: declared the status_tier_renewal and renewal_dating 'charged that tier's annual fee' clauses in the lapsed-renewal overwrite. The base reading 65.00 is now retired by declaration, so the renewal has one answer.
- D3: added the Student term-limit conversion to the tier the new year is held at (rf_student_terms, rf_term_limit_reached).
- E1: anniversary test is now MONTHS(NOW, expiry) >= -anchor, which is inclusive of the boundary day. Here MONTHS(2026-10-05, 2026-08-31) = -2 >= -2 (boundary 2026-10-31), so the anniversary is kept.
- F1: renewal_tier_fee is removed as a factor. The tier selection now lives in the baseline paragraph, and renewal_conversion_grace_credit is added. The renewal now has 4 factors: loyalty (method), cardmember credit, conversion grace credit and late fee (parameters). Gold moved 53.50 -> 43.50, fall-back 45.50 -> 65.00.
- F3: upgrade_fee_basis tiers now test 'no upgrade difference fee from an earlier upgrade' (a ledger fact that divides customers) in place of the universal 'base fee paid'. Gold moved 51.25 -> 61.25 because the renewal fee it nets moved.
- Observations closed in the charter: O5 (add-on window wording), O6 (withdrawn request dated by request date), O7 (docstring ordering words), O8, O9. Persona unchanged: it carries no figure.

[Revision round 3 — audit revision_2]
- E2: rf_student_terms now subtracts charges refunded as duplicates. This matches the rule's 'Student Club membership years ... paid', and the base term-count sentence is declared in overwrite. Not reached on this Heroes world.
- O13: the four superseded fee sentences now map to a scoping sentence that limits the replacement to renewals of expired memberships, so base keeps governing on-time renewals and new memberships.
- Scored values are unchanged (renewal 43.50, upgrade 61.25) and were re-verified by check_compute --task 0.
user_scenario:
You are Marisol Quennell-Abernathy, 47, a retired Army logistics sergeant who now coordinates volunteers at a food pantry on the west side of Columbus. You have shopped at Northgate for years on a Heroes Club membership, and a neighbour keeps telling you the Club Plus reward pays for itself, so you are calling member services to upgrade your membership to Club Plus today. That is the first thing you say. You don't keep track of your membership dates and you don't bring them up.
When the agent asks who you are, you give your phone number, 6145550137, and if a second detail is wanted, your date of birth, 1979-04-22 (April 22, 1979). Your email, marisol.quennellabernathy@fastmail.com, and your ZIP code, 43221, you give only if they are asked for. If the agent asks for your membership number you read it off your card: 100163029481.
You still have a Northgate Rewards Visa but you have stopped using it. Whenever the agent asks how you want to pay for anything today, you say it goes on your own Chase credit card, not a Northgate card.
If the agent tells you the membership has to be renewed before the upgrade can be done, you are a little embarrassed that you hadn't noticed, and you agree to renew it and pay the renewal yourself. When the agent hands the renewal payment over for you to complete, you run it with exactly the details the agent reads out to you, paying on your Chase credit card, and then tell the agent it went through, reading back the receipt if asked. If the agent mentions that your veteran verification has run out and the renewal comes back as a regular Club membership, you accept that and say you will sort the verification out another time, since you are going to Plus anyway.
Once the renewal is paid you want the upgrade put through right away, and you tell the agent to go ahead and charge it to the same Chase card. You have no idea what either the renewal or the upgrade should cost and never suggest a figure; if a figure sounds high to you, you only ask how it was worked out and accept the explanation. When the agent confirms that your membership has been upgraded to Club Plus, you thank them and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: Value: the membership reference returned by find_membership_holdings. Basis: it is the only membership on her profile (find_membership_holdings by customer_id returns one row). Uniqueness: no other membership exists for this customer.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.renewal_tier: Value: Northgate Club Membership. Basis: lapsed-renewal rule 'The new membership year is held at the Northgate Club Membership, the tier a Student Club or Heroes Club renewal converts to, when the membership is a Student Club or Heroes Club membership whose status verification on record is not valid on the first day of the new membership year'; eligibility_verified_through 2026-07-31 is before 2026-09-01. Uniqueness: Heroes Club would ignore the lapsed verification; the downgrade-target branch needs a Plus tier with a confirmed downgrade request (none); no other tier is named by the rule.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_term_start_date: Value: 2026-09-01. Basis: base membership_renewal_dating 'Within that limit the new year starts the day after the lapsed expiry_date'; expiry 2026-08-31 plus 2 calendar months is 2026-10-31, today 2026-10-05 is within it. Uniqueness: the payment-date start (2026-10-05) applies only beyond the limit.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_expiry_date: Value: 2027-08-31. Basis: the year 'runs term_length_months' (12) from 2026-09-01, ending the day before the same calendar date twelve months later (enrollment-terms dating sentence). Uniqueness: any other date would not span twelve calendar months from 2026-09-01.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.renewal_fee: Value: 43.50. Factors: annual fee of the tier the new year is held at 65.00 (Heroes verification valid through 2026-07-31, not valid on 2026-09-01, so the year is held at Northgate Club Membership — the baseline paragraph itself states this conversion); loyalty reduction 4.50 (paid years = 1 new + 9 renewal charges - 1 duplicate refund = 9, five-to-nine tier flat 4.50; the near-miss raw count 10 would give 8% = 5.20); cardmember renewal credit 12.00 (restricted Northgate Rewards Visa Signature linked; closed store card excluded); conversion grace credit 10.00 (verification ended 2026-07-31, 32 days before the 2026-09-01 first day, no more than 60); late renewal reinstatement fee 5.00 (35 days after 2026-08-31, 15-45 band). 65.00 - 4.50 - 12.00 - 10.00 + 5.00 = 43.50.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.tender: Value: other_credit_card. Basis: tool docstring 'other_credit_card — charged to any other credit card the member names'; the member says she pays on her own Chase credit card, not a Northgate card. Uniqueness: northgate_visa/northgate_store_card are Northgate cards she declines; cash_or_debit, shop_card, reward_certificate do not describe a Chase credit card; not_applicable is never used for a payment.
